fields.title: Choose a Model
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each step, choose the class and justify it.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Determine message language 2. Extract date from text 3. Write support reply 4. Analyze 200 reviews and extract topics 5. Check text for forbidden content
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1, 2, 5 — small: simple structural tasks, cost and speed matter, result is verified programmatically. 3 — medium: text quality matters, but complex reasoning is not required. 4 — medium or flagship depending on requirements, and crucially this is not a user-facing scenario, meaning latency is not critical and it can run in the background. Rule of thumb: first ask if a person is waiting for a response.
